# TPMS light concealment mod

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Trim black vinyl window cling and stick it onto the plastic instrument panel's TPMS light. [t629]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Get black vinyl window cling decorations.
2. Trim a piece of the vinyl to be approximately postage stamp size.
3. Clean off the plastic on your instrument panel to remove any dust.
4. Stick the trimmed vinyl bit onto the TPMS light.

_Procedure reported by [t629]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-disable-tpms-dash-light-for-1-five-minute-easy-mod.9682/>_
